items.title: Budget/maintenance CronJobs hang for hours: an interactive-login model (chatgpt/, github_copilot/) in agent settings triggers LiteLLM's device login during settings validation
items.summary:
## Summary

An **interactive-login model** saved in an org's (or member's) agent settings makes the budget/maintenance CronJobs **hang for hours**. When the maintenance runner validates that org's persisted agent settings, constructing the SDK `LLM` object eagerly asks LiteLLM to resolve the provider, and LiteLLM providers that use OAuth **device-code login start an interactive sign-in** that blocks (synchronous `time.sleep` + `httpx`) for up to ~15 minutes per call on a headless job with no TTY
